_note: Settings for the DDD Perth 2026 booth kiosk at /ddd-2026. See docs/ddd-2026.md. The kiosk reads these from /ddd-2026/api/config.json, built from this file. `eventDate` is ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) and is shown as a day and month. Sign-ups go to the same Web3Forms inbox as the site's own forms (the access key comes from forms.json). Every `links` URL gets a QR code (the kiosk uses luma, slack and linkedin); `email` is shown as text. Open the kiosk with ?booth on the booth screen and tablets (see docs/ddd-2026.md).

game.prize: Top score at 4pm wins a prize — plus a random draw for everyone who plays
